name: Manticore

traits.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
traits.description: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws, or three with its tail spikes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

tactics: The manticore stays airborne, raking targets with volleys of tail spikes from range, and only closes to bite when a target is weakened. At Umbrage Hill it circles Adabra Gwynn's windmill — a flying skirmish that punishes parties with no ranged answer.
